Problem: Provide a complete, formal solution to this quantitative interview problem. Clearly define all variables and random objects, state the required output (exact expression, probability, expectation, algorithm, or numeric value as applicable), and specify any assumptions needed for well-posedness. Include constraints/ranges for parameters, and require the final answer in simplified form. Do not include hints or solution steps in the prompt text.
comments.proposed_solution_outline:
Approach: Identify the governing model/formula (counting argument, conditional expectation, stochastic-process identity, optimization, etc.) and map the problem variables to that framework.
Intuition: Explain why this framework fits, including the key symmetry/independence/linearity/geometric insight used.
Correctness: Derive the result step by step from definitions; justify each transformation and handle edge cases/boundary values explicitly.
Complexity: If computational, provide time/space complexity; if purely mathematical, state derivation length/constant-time evaluation once formula is known.
Code Notes: Provide a minimal, numerically stable implementation (if relevant), with clearly defined inputs/outputs and test on one representative example.
